keyPoints.text: The new site must be live by 12 January, ahead of the open day on 18 January.
keyPoints.quote: We need it live by the 12th, so the receptionists can practise.

keyPoints.text: The budget is fixed at 18,000 pounds with nothing on top.
keyPoints.quote: Budget is the fixed eighteen thousand pounds we agreed in the proposal, nothing on top.

actions.text: Send three homepage concepts to Linda
actions.quote: I'll have three homepage concepts to you in two weeks.

actions.text: Ask Marianne to organise a photo day
actions.quote: I'll ask Marianne to organise a photo day, she looks after the rota.
I'll send over the contract addendum today.

risks.text: Nobody knows who has the domain login.
risks.quote: nobody knows who has the login for the domain.

risks.text: The booking plugin may not work on the new platform.
risks.quote: It's a fifteen year old plugin and the new platform may not support it.

risks.text: The 12 January launch needs the content by mid December, and it is not in hand yet.
risks.quote: That's tight but fine if we have content by mid December.

traps.what: Aiko offered to write all treatment pages then backed out.
traps.quote: I can write all the treatment pages, there are about thirty. Hmm, no, I can't do thirty by December on my own.

traps.what: Aiko's request to Linda's team was not accepted ('We'll see'). Not an action for Linda.
traps.quote: We'll see. Everyone is flat out until the new year.

traps.what: Colours were raised and deferred, no decision.
traps.quote: We can talk about that when you see the concepts.

traps.what: The 8th was a mishearing; the open day is the 18th.
traps.quote: did you say the open day is the 18th or the 8th?
